name: Star Crush
description:
About This Game

The Classic Returns... and It Bites!

Remember the feeling of piloting a triangular ship through endless space? Star Crush is a tribute to the legend, but with modern rules and deadly stakes.

There's no room for mistakes. No regeneration. No shields.

One Hit — One Kill

We've stripped away everything unnecessary. You have no health bar.

• Grazed by an asteroid? Dead.

• Hit by an enemy laser? Dead.

• Collided with an enemy? Dead.

This applies to your enemies too. Pure skill, pure reflexes. The game may seem simple at first glance, but try scoring over 3000 points - it becomes a true challenge even for experienced players.

Game Features

• Hardcore Gameplay: The "One Hit One Kill" mechanic keeps you on edge every second

• Bosses: Three unique bosses requiring perfect mastery of the mechanics

• High Score Chase: Global leaderboards, friend leaderboards, daily and monthly rankings

• Controls: Gamepad and keyboard support

You Decide the Future of Star Crush

Right now, you're playing the foundation of a future full-scale game. We aim to create our dream project, but we need your help.

What would you like the full version to look like?

Ship upgrades? New weapon types? Or keep it pure hardcore with no progression? We read every discussion. Join in, vote for new features, and help us make Star Crush a legend.

Join the Development!

Leave a review or post in the discussions to suggest an idea. Your name could appear in the credits of the full version!

Ready to test your nerves? Fire up the engines!
short_desc: Survive the chaos of deep space in this intense top-down arcade shooter! Crush asteroids, defeat enemy ships, and fight deadly bosses with lightning-fast reflexes.
